<function name="SetAutoStretch" parent="DLabelEditable" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Sets whether the editable label should stretch to the text entered or not.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<added>2020.08.12</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="stretch" type="boolean">Whether the editable label should stretch to the text entered or not.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
